root.label: Shyam Metalics Maharashtra steel plant investment deal

events.label: Shyam Metalics Maharashtra steel plant investment deal

slots.name: investment amount
slots.sentence: India's Shyam Metalics and Energy (SHYE.NS) on Friday said it has signed a deal with the Maharashtra government to invest 500 billion rupees ($5.19 billion) to set up a steel plant in the western state.

slots.name: plant capacity
slots.sentence: The integrated metal producer will build a 9 million-metric-tonnes-per-year greenfield steel complex in Chandrapur in the state's Vidarbha region, the company said in an exchange filing.
